title: RejectedFeatures
description: A mod that aims to add to Minecraft features that were rejected by Mojang.
body:
# Minecraft's Rejected Features

Minecraft players have suggested thousands of ideas over the years.  
Some were added to the game, while others ended up on Mojang's official [**Rejected Suggestions List**](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/360005029872--Archived-Previously-Considered-Suggestions).

This mod brings some of those rejected ideas to life so we can try them out !

***

# 🧟 Zombie Players

When a player is killed by a zombie, a new zombie can spawn withtheir equipment.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_03219aa2-0354-4590-a279-0807366c23d2.png)

***

# 🎈 Levitation Potions

Levitation has existed in Minecraft for years, yet it still can't be brewed into a potion.

I also created an alternative version brewed with Fireworks which is shorter but with a much stronger effect.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_397322ad-550a-42be-a1e9-8617a1340d98.png)

***

# 📦 Double Ender Chest

One of the most requested  updates is finally here.

Place two Ender Chests next to each other to create a **Double Ender Chest**, with twice the storage.

The first slots remain linked to your regular Ender Chest.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_cb37c42d-9695-4c9c-ab38-f005d6e7b4ae.png)

 

***

# 🎨 Paint Brush

Minecraft is designed around placing one block at a time.

This mod breaks that rule with the **Paint Brush**, a tool capable of placing blocks in a **3×3 area** if you keep it in your left hand.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_73e5994c-2bdc-45d2-8642-d84ed8b79699.png)

  

***

# 💎 Amethyst Equipment

The copper tools were added, time for the Amethyst (which is cooler imo)

All the tools are based on a streak mecanic, the more you break the same block, you harvest the same crop, you hit the same mob, the more effecient the tool gets.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_e2608078-8783-43bb-9b47-c2bc0aeb5c04.png)

***

# 🏚️ Illusioner Hut

The Illusioner is in the game since 1.12 but is still impossible to get without commands.

This mod adds a dedicated structure for it: the **Illusioner Hut**.

It's upside down so the illusioner is named Dinnerbone lol

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_375eac07-c0bf-4291-a8be-dc26d165ddfb.png)

.![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_7618f6b7-8120-4c1c-9c20-3741c61bb0b7.png)

***

# 🌞 Blinding Sunlight

Do not stare at the sun. That's an advice.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_86d6cccb-4c3b-4b35-b40c-97f3a50b04c2.png)

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_5b67dc3b-5922-4a99-886d-172601c7cf03.png)

***

# 🪨 Bedrock Breaker

Getting the advancement **How did we get there** will give you a rune to upgrade your pickaxe and make it able to break bedrock.

But mining Bedrock damages the player, like getting the master sword in Zelda BOTW.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_ca17a39d-ba87-42dd-80a2-5999b7a3864b.png)

 

***

# 😢 Crying Obsidian Portal

Crying Obsidian can finally be used to create a special portal.

Instead of leading into the Nether itself, this portal transports players to the **Nether Roof**, offering a convenient way to access this place.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_30a8de23-aeef-4de6-b199-74e9b84b893f.png)

***

# 🟧 Copper Oxidation

This mod adds a way to manually oxidize copper blocks using water bottles. 

Also, with apple Vinegar you can reverse the oxydation.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_f717f3fe-c0ad-4dc5-99bc-04c638959286.png)

 

***

# 🏮 Hanging Lanterns

Lanterns now have a variant that can be attached directly to walls.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_1975321e-b982-4eb1-bb75-be47ae78e667.png)

***

# 🌳 Bark

Stripping logs now gives you **Bark** that can give your minecraft skin a little tanning. It can be washed with a water bucket.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_5e75604c-e12e-43fc-a57d-8b4c09d14c3e.png)
